library.pageSubtitle: Recipes, station procedures, cleaning schedules, and one-off notes — every published document, organised by category.
library.emptyHeading: The library starts with the first procedure
library.emptyBody: Once you publish a procedure it will appear here. Use "New procedure" to start with a recipe, station procedure, or cleaning schedule.

categories.pageSubtitle: Categories organise the library. The seed set below ships with the platform; rename or add more once the editor is in.
categories.renameBody: Editing categories lands with the SOP Library. Until then, these six cover the brief: recipes, equipment handling, station procedures, cleaning schedules, admin, and delivery.

new.pageSubtitle: Create a procedure for your team. Add the details below and you can add the steps, ingredients, media and access settings.

recipe.pageSubtitle: Create a recipe for your team. Fill in the details below and add the steps.
recipe.ingredientsSubtitle: Add ingredients and quantities. You can scale the recipe later.
recipe.scalingSubtitle: Adjust quantities automatically for different portion sizes.
recipe.methodSubtitle: Add the step-by-step instructions, including any critical control steps.

titles.recipeSubtitle: Create a recipe for your team. Fill in the details below and add the steps.
titles.stationSubtitle: Create a station procedure for your team. Fill in the details below and add the steps.
titles.cleaningSubtitle: Create a cleaning schedule for your team. Fill in the details below and add the steps.
titles.generalSubtitle: Create an operational procedure for your team. Fill in the details below and add the steps.

types.label: Procedure type

sidebar.aiImportBody: Upload a PDF, Word or photo and let AI create a draft for you.

new.comingSoonHeading: The procedure editor lands with the SOP Library
new.comingSoonBody: Until then, manage employees and settings from the sidebar. The procedure editor (title, steps, critical limits, allergens, attachments) will arrive in Stage 2.

form.detailsSubtitle: Title and category — what the procedure is called and where it lives in the library.
form.purposeSectionSubtitle: Explain why this procedure exists and what it achieves.
form.purposePlaceholder: Enter the purpose of this procedure…
form.contentSectionSubtitle: Add the steps, ingredients, media and other content for this procedure.
form.purposeSubtitle: One or two sentences on why this procedure exists. Shown to cooks before they start.
form.audiencePlaceholder: e.g. Anyone working the cold station or prep. Knife certification required.
form.allergenDetailPlaceholder: e.g. In the finishing oil, step 8. Check the ticket before it leaves the pass.
form.prereqPlaceholder: e.g. Wash your hands and sanitise the bench.
form.stepPlaceholder: Describe what the cook does at this step.
form.critical: Critical step (must include a critical limit)
form.limitDescriptionHint: Optional short summary shown next to the value.
form.limitDescriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Hold for at least 30 seconds
form.correctiveActionConditionPlaceholder: If the limit is not met…
form.instructionsPlaceholder: Describe what the cook does at this step.
form.previewSoon: Preview lands in a future slice.
form.contentSubtitle: Build the body block by block — text, steps, recipes, images, warnings, attachments.

composer.empty: No blocks yet — pick one below.
composer.emptyBody: Add text, steps, recipes, photographs — whatever fits how this procedure is actually taught at the station.

errors.needStep: Add at least one method step before publishing.

errors.missingPurpose: Add a purpose in English and Spanish before publishing.
errors.missingPurposeDraft: Add a purpose in at least one language.
errors.missingIngredient: Add at least one ingredient with a name.
errors.missingAccess: Pick an access level before publishing.
errors.invalidInput: Some fields need attention. Review and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in and try again.
